dialogs.about: 주민센터에 가기 전에 사위와 서류를 챙겨요

lines.en: Good morning, Mother. Are you going out today?
Yes, I want to apply for a certificate.
Do you have your ID card?
Yes, I put it in my bag this morning.
You also need a photocopy of it.
Can you make one for me, please?
lines.ko: 저 대신 한 장 만들어 줄래요?

lines.en: Of course. I will do it right now.
Thank you. Where is my seal?
It is beside the phone on the table.
Good. I hope the queue is short today.

dialogs.about: 주민센터에서 공무원에게 증명서 신청을 도와 달라고 해요

lines.en: Excuse me. Is this the right queue?
Yes, Ma'am. Please take this application.
Thank you. My eyes are not good.
I can help you. Is this your first visit?
No. I filled out a form here last year.
Good. Please put your signature here.
Do I need my seal too?
No, your signature is enough today.
When will the certificate be ready?
I will register it and print it now.
